decisions.title: Resolution of UQ-P9-01 — Structural Boundary & Location
decisions.decision: Use OPTION 1: Dedicated domain/seo/ subsystem. SEO 2.0 will live under domain/seo/ with a clean subsystem API, consumed by domain/cms/ and integrated with a CLI in sps2/tools/.
decisions.rationale: Preserves domain isolation per .sps/architecture/SPS2-REPOSITORY-ARCHITECTURE.md line 59, keeps CMS decoupled from presentation and audit concerns, and provides an independent advisory rollback boundary.

Do NOT invent INP numeric thresholds

decisions.title: Resolution of UQ-P9-03 — Pre-Deployment Audit Enforcement
decisions.decision: Use OPTION 3: Implement the dual-mode CLI concept: deterministic exit code on CRITICAL failures in deployment mode, and formal SEO evidence artifact generation (EV-SEO-*) for Level 4 deployment sign-off.
decisions.rationale: Satisfies the roadmap rule forbidding shipping without a pre-deployment audit step, enables CI pipelines to fail fast on critical SEO bugs, and provides an unforgeable machine-verifiable audit trail for P13 Deployment Readiness.
